truth: large round openings=locating holes; small round openings=empty sites; P07-P12 visibly four front-facing devices

current_code.units: 640x360 half-resolution mask cells after 2x2 mean, not photo pixels or padded display box pixels

conclusions: Three visible classes have separated external geometry in this session.
Large-hole diameter/area ratios in same photo are more credible than uncalibrated phone brightness.
High threshold may retain only LED central bright disk and lose rectangular body; body presence must use complete external component.

Large-hole interior background texture may fragment a high-threshold mask; reject using complete large-hole contour before admitting small/uncertain fragments. Mechanism hypothesis, not a replayed FPGA failure.
Small holes and locating holes must be discriminated by size plus contour, not brightness, row-above/below rule, or all orange edge pixels.
Present and empty do not share a single bright-object threshold; preserve separate gray masks and inspect their geometry margins.

Current search detector receives pre-Sobel RGB only. The orange overlay is not evidence of edge features participating in four-target classification. Native Sobel features must be explicitly routed/aligned if used for verification.
Threshold changes require synthetic geometry/boundary regression and same-board validation. No numeric native threshold derived directly from this phone batch.
next_scope: Basic present/empty/locating class gates, maintain disabled observer build for acquisition; no code/build without later action request. No revival of jitter investigation.
